name: pipe_axi
description: axisymmetric Stokes, form laplacian (the API's default is stress), on the instance mesh of pipe = [p1, p2]: the axis condition on axis_attributes, no-slip on wall, the traction (0, +p_in, 0) on inlet (sigma_form n = -p_in n with n = -e_z), do_nothing on outlet; Hagen-Poiseuille u_z = p_in (R^2 - r^2) / (4 nu Lz), u_r = u_theta = 0, p = p_in (1 - z/Lz), Q = pi R^4 p_in / (8 nu Lz), exact in P2/P1
mesh: the mesher's unstructured mesh of the document (gmsh, bounded axisymmetric mode, algorithm and options of axmp-mesher), mesh.size = R/8, geometry order 2 (the default: straight edges, with nodes); one process

u_z.what: max |u_z - u_z,HP| / u_max at the seven sample points (vertices, edge midpoints, centroid) of every element

u_r.what: max |u_r| / u_max at the seven sample points (vertices, edge midpoints, centroid) of every element

u_theta.what: max |u_theta| / u_max at the seven sample points (vertices, edge midpoints, centroid) of every element

p.what: max |p - p_HP| / p_in at the seven sample points (vertices, edge midpoints, centroid) of every element

Q_outlet.what: |Q(outlet) - Q| / Q, 2 pi r u . n by the instrument (the 2 pi r is the test's)

unrecorded_platforms: the lr7 nodes of feature rocky8 (n0150 to n0153), a second processor model of the lr7 partition
any other partition the gate is pointed at

document.name: pipe_axi
document.description: an axisymmetric pipe of radius R and length Lz split at z = Lz/2 into the regions p1 and p2; the axis r = 0 is named by no boundary
